  124:   const code = String(err?.code || "").toLowerCase();
  125:   return (
  126:     code.includes("failed-precondition") ||
  127:     msg.includes("failed_precondition") ||
  128:     (msg.includes("index") && msg.includes("create")) ||
  129:     (msg.includes("requires") && msg.includes("index"))
  130:   );
  131: }

  133: async function tryBoundsByField(db, lotteryKey, field, scanLimit = 50) {
  134:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
  135:   const base = db.collection("draws").where("lottery_key", "==", lotteryKey);
  136: 
  137:   const ascSnap = await base
  138:     .orderBy(field, "asc")
  139:     .orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc")
  140:     .limit(scanLimit)
  141:     .get();
  142: 
  143:   const descSnap = await base
  144:     .orderBy(field, "desc")
  145:     .orderBy(DOC_ID, "desc")
  146:     .limit(scanLimit)
  147:     .get();
  148: 
  149:   if (ascSnap.empty || descSnap.empty) {
  150:     return {
  151:       ok: false,
  152:       source: `where(lottery_key)+orderBy(${field})+docId(scan=${scanLimit})`,
  153:     };
  154:   }
  155: 
  156:   function pickFirstValidYmdFromDocs(docs, fieldName) {
  157:     for (const doc of docs || []) {
  158:       const v = doc?.data()?.[fieldName];
  159:       const y = normalizeToYMD(v);
  160:       if (y && isISODate(y)) {
  161:         return { ymd: y, docId: doc.id, raw: v };
  162:       }
  163:     }
  164:     return { ymd: null, docId: null, raw: null };
  165:   }
  166: 
  167:   const minPick = pickFirstValidYmdFromDocs(ascSnap.docs, field);
  168:   const maxPick = pickFirstValidYmdFromDocs(descSnap.docs, field);
  169: 
  170:   return {
  171:     ok: !!(minPick.ymd && maxPick.ymd),
  172:     minYmd: minPick.ymd,
  173:     maxYmd: maxPick.ymd,
  174:     source: `where(lottery_key)+orderBy(${field})+docId(scan=${scanLimit})`,
  175:     minDocId: minPick.docId,
  176:     maxDocId: maxPick.docId,
  177:     minRaw: minPick.raw ?? null,
  178:     maxRaw: maxPick.raw ?? null,
  179:   };
  180: }

  182: async function fallbackBoundsByDocIdEdges(db, lotteryKey, edgeLimit) {
  183:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
  184:   const base = db.collection("draws").where("lottery_key", "==", lotteryKey);
  185: 
  186:   const ascSnap = await base.orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc").limit(edgeLimit).get();
  187:   const descSnap = await base.orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc").limitToLast(edgeLimit).get();
  188: 
  189:   const merged = [...ascSnap.docs, ...descSnap.docs];
  190:   const { minYmd, maxYmd } = pickMinMaxFromDocs(merged);
  191: 
  192:   return {
  193:     ok: !!(minYmd && maxYmd),
  194:     minYmd: minYmd || null,
  195:     maxYmd: maxYmd || null,
  196:     source: `fallback_edges_docId(limit=${edgeLimit})`,
  197:     sampleCount: merged.length,
  198:     firstDocId: ascSnap.docs[0]?.id || null,
  199:     lastDocId: descSnap.docs[descSnap.docs.length - 1]?.id || null,
  200:   };
  201: }

  182: async function fallbackBoundsByDocIdEdges(db, lotteryKey, edgeLimit) {

   83: /**
   84:  * Pega o primeiro YMD válido dentro de um conjunto de docs.
   85:  */
   86: function pickFirstValidYmd(docs, fieldName) {
   87:   for (const doc of docs || []) {
   88:     const isSnap = doc && typeof doc.data === "function";
   89:     const d = isSnap ? doc.data() : (doc || {});
   90: 
   91:     // prioridade: fieldName; depois tenta o "outro" campo como fallback
   92:     let raw = d?.[fieldName];
   93: 
   94:     if (raw == null) {
   95:       if (fieldName === "ymd") raw = d?.date;
   96:       else if (fieldName === "date") raw = d?.ymd;
   97:       else raw = d?.date ?? d?.ymd;
   98:     }
   99: 
  100:     const y = normalizeToYMD(raw);
  101:     if (y && isISODateStrict(y)) {
  102:       return { ymd: y, docId: isSnap ? doc.id : (doc?.id || null), raw };
  103:     }
  104:   }
  105:   return { ymd: null, docId: null, raw: null };
  106: }

   86: function pickFirstValidYmd(docs, fieldName) {
   87:   for (const doc of docs || []) {
   88:     const isSnap = doc && typeof doc.data === "function";
   89:     const d = isSnap ? doc.data() : (doc || {});
   90: 
   91:     // prioridade: fieldName; depois tenta o "outro" campo como fallback
   92:     let raw = d?.[fieldName];
   93: 
   94:     if (raw == null) {
   95:       if (fieldName === "ymd") raw = d?.date;
   96:       else if (fieldName === "date") raw = d?.ymd;
   97:       else raw = d?.date ?? d?.ymd;
   98:     }
   99: 
  100:     const y = normalizeToYMD(raw);
  101:     if (y && isISODateStrict(y)) {
  102:       return { ymd: y, docId: isSnap ? doc.id : (doc?.id || null), raw };
  103:     }
  104:   }
  105:   return { ymd: null, docId: null, raw: null };
  106: }

  191:  * - KING_FETCH_PER_LOTTERY=0 => volta ao modo antigo (1 request com todos lotteries[])
  192:  */
  193: const FETCH_PER_LOTTERY =
  194:   String(process.env.KING_FETCH_PER_LOTTERY || "").trim() === "0" ? false : true;
  195: 
  196: // ✅ Debug do fetch (log por lotteryId)
  197: // Ative com: set KING_FETCH_DEBUG=1
  198: const KING_FETCH_DEBUG = String(process.env.KING_FETCH_DEBUG || "").trim() === "1";
  199: 
  200: // ✅ Debug leve do override FEDERAL
  201: // Ative com: set KING_OVERRIDE_DEBUG=1
  202: const KING_OVERRIDE_DEBUG = String(process.env.KING_OVERRIDE_DEBUG || "").trim() === "1";
  203: 
  204: /**
  205:  * ✅ Blindagem contra datas futuras (não busca API, não escreve no FS)
  206:  * - ALLOW_FUTURE_DATE=1 => libera (use com MUITO cuidado / apenas para testes)
  207:  */
  208: const ALLOW_FUTURE_DATE = String(process.env.ALLOW_FUTURE_DATE || "").trim() === "1";
  209: 
  210: /**
  211:  * =========================
  212:  * ✅ Regras de negócio: UF x lottery_key
  213:  * =========================
  214:  *
  215:  * IMPORTANTE:
  216:  * - lottery_key identifica a loteria/fonte (ex.: PT_RIO)
  217:  * - uf deve ser o estado (ex.: RJ), pois o frontend consulta por UF ("RJ")
  218:  *
  219:  * Se uf ficar "PT_RIO", o bounds por UF quebra.
  220:  */
  221: const RJ_STATE_CODE = "RJ";
  222: const RJ_LOTTERY_KEY = "PT_RIO";
  223: 
  224: const FEDERAL_STATE_CODE = "BR";
  225: const FEDERAL_LOTTERY_KEY = "FEDERAL";
  226: 
  227: const LOOK_STATE_CODE = "GO";
  228: const LOOK_LOTTERY_KEY = "LOOK";
  229: 
  230: const NACIONAL_STATE_CODE = "BR";
  231: const NACIONAL_LOTTERY_KEY = "NACIONAL";
  232: 
  233: function resolveUfFromLotteryKey(lotteryKey) {
  234:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  235:   if (!lk) return null;
  236:   if (lk === RJ_LOTTERY_KEY) return RJ_STATE_CODE;
  237:   if (lk === FEDERAL_LOTTERY_KEY) return FEDERAL_STATE_CODE;
  238:   if (lk === LOOK_LOTTERY_KEY) return LOOK_STATE_CODE;
  239:   if (lk === NACIONAL_LOTTERY_KEY) return NACIONAL_STATE_CODE;
  240: 
  241:   // se for uma UF padrão de 2 letras (SP, MG, DF etc.), preserva
  242:   if (/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(lk)) return lk;
  243: 
  244:   // fallback: não inventa UF
  245:   return null;
  246: }
  247: 
  248: /**
  249:  * =========================
  250:  * Date helpers (BRT via TZ)
  251:  * =========================
  252:  */
  253: 
  254: function pad2(n) {
  255:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  256: }
  257: 
  258: function todayYMDLocal() {
  259:   try {
  260:     const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
  261:       timeZone: "America/Sao_Paulo",
  262:       year: "numeric",
  263:       month: "2-digit",
  264:       day: "2-digit",
  265:     });
  266:     return fmt.format(new Date()); // YYYY-MM-DD
  267:   } catch {
  268:     const d = new Date();
  269:     return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
  270:   }
  271: }
  272: 
  273: function isFutureISODate(ymd) {
  274:   // Compare lexicográfico funciona para YYYY-MM-DD
  275:   const t = todayYMDLocal();
  276:   return String(ymd || "").trim() > t;
  277: }

   38:   if (!ymd) return NaN;

   44: function dayDiffInclusiveUTC(ymdFrom, ymdTo) {
   45:   const toUTC = (ymd) => {
   46:     const m = String(ymd).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
   47:     if (!m) return null;
   48:     return new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3])));
   49:   };
   50: 
   51:   const da = toUTC(ymdFrom);
   52:   const db = toUTC(ymdTo);
   53:   if (!da || !db) return NaN;
   54: 
   55:   const ms = db.getTime() - da.getTime();
   56:   if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) return NaN;
   57: 
   58:   return Math.floor(ms / 86400000) + 1;
   59: }

  475: function clampRangeToBounds(next, minDate, maxDate) {
  476:   const f = next?.from;
  477:   const t = next?.to;
  478: 
  479:   if (!isISODate(f) || !isISODate(t)) return null;
  480:   if (!minDate || !maxDate) return null;
  481:   if (!isISODate(minDate) || !isISODate(maxDate)) return null;
  482: 
  483:   let from = f < minDate ? minDate : f;
  484:   let to = t > maxDate ? maxDate : t;
  485: 
  486:   if (from > to) to = from;
  487:   return { from, to };
  488: }

  490: function normalizeLoteriaKey(v) {

  494:

  507:     .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, "_")

   30: 
   31: function pad2(n) {
   32:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
   33: }
   34: 
   35: function isISODate(s) {
   36:   return /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.test(String(s || ""));
   37: }
   38: 
   39: function formatBR(iso) {
   40:   if (!isISODate(iso)) return "";
   41:   const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-");
   42:   return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
   43: }
   44: 
   45: function toUTCDate(iso) {
   46:   if (!isISODate(iso)) return null;
   47:   const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
   48:   if (!y || !m || !d) return null;
   49:   return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
   50: }
   51: 
   52: function fromUTCDate(dt) {
   53:   if (!(dt instanceof Date) || !Number.isFinite(dt.getTime())) return null;
   54:   const y = dt.getUTCFullYear();
   55:   const m = pad2(dt.getUTCMonth() + 1);
   56:   const d = pad2(dt.getUTCDate());
   57:   return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
   58: }
   59: 
   60: function clamp(n, a, b) {
   61:   return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n));
   62: }
   63: 
   64: function clampDateISO(iso, minISO, maxISO) {
   65:   const dt = toUTCDate(iso);
   66:   const minDt = toUTCDate(minISO);
   67:   const maxDt = toUTCDate(maxISO);
   68: 
   69:   if (!minDt || !maxDt) return isISODate(iso) ? iso : null;
   70:   if (!dt) return maxISO;
   71: 
   72:   const clamped = new Date(clamp(dt.getTime(), minDt.getTime(), maxDt.getTime()));
   73:   return fromUTCDate(clamped) || maxISO;
   74: }
   75: 
   76: function daysBetweenUTC(aISO, bISO) {
   77:   const a = toUTCDate(aISO);
   78:   const b = toUTCDate(bISO);
   79:   if (!a || !b) return 0;
   80:   const ms = b.getTime() - a.getTime();
   81:   if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) return 0;
   82:   return Math.floor(ms / 86400000);

   40: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
   41:   const s0 = safeStr(value);
   42:   if (!s0) return "";
   43: 
   44:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
   45: 
   46:   const mhx = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);
   47:   if (mhx) return `${pad2(mhx[1])}:00`;
   48: 
   49:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
   50:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}:${pad2(mISO[2])}`;
   51: 
   52:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
   53:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}:00`;
   54: 
   55:   return s0;
   56: }

   58: }

   46: function ymdToBR(ymd) {
   47:   const m = String(ymd || "")
   48:     .trim()
   49:     .match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
   50:   if (!m) return "";

   52: }
   53: 
   54: function ymdToUTCDate(ymd) {
   55:   const m = String(ymd || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
   56:   if (!m) return null;
   57:   return new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3])));
   58: }
   59: 
   60: function diffDaysUTC(aYmd, bYmd) {
   61:   const a = ymdToUTCDate(aYmd);
   62:   const b = ymdToUTCDate(bYmd);
   63:   if (!a || !b) return NaN;
   64:   return Math.floor((b.getTime() - a.getTime()) / 86400000);
   65: }

   52: function clampYmd(ymd, minYmd, maxYmd) {
   53:   const d = safeStr(ymd);
   54:   if (!isYMD(d)) return "";

   61:   if (isYMD(max) && out > max) out = max;
   62: 
   63:   return out;
   64: }

  490: /* =========================

  493: 
  494: async function runPool(items, worker, concurrency = 3) {
  495:   const queue = [...items];
  496:   const runners = Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, concurrency) }, async () => {
  497:     while (queue.length) {
  498:       const it = queue.shift();
  499:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
  500:       await worker(it);
  501:     }
  502:   });
  503:   await Promise.all(runners);
  504: }

   85: function drawTs(draw) {
   86:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
   87:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
   88: 
   89:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
   90: 
   91:   const [Y, M, D] = String(y).split("-").map(Number);
   92:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
   93: 
   94:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) {
   95:     return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
   96:   }
   97: 
   98:   return Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D) + mins * 60 * 1000;
   99: }
  100: 
  101: function drawKey(draw) {
  102:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
  103:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
  104:   return isYMD(y) && h ? `${y}|${h}` : "";
  105: }
  106: 
  107: function hasDrawAtHour(draws, hourBucket) {
  108:   const target = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
  109:   if (!target) return false;
  110: 
  111:   return (Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : []).some((d) => {
  112:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
  113:     return h === target;
  114:   });
  115: }

   27: function drawTs(draw) {
   28:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
   29:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
   30:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
   31: 
   32:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
   33:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
   34:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
   35:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
   36:   return base + add;
   37: }
